calendarFeed.title: Calendar feed
calendarFeed.description: Subscribe to your upcoming bills in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or any app that supports iCal. The link is read-only and shows payments only: no balances or account numbers.
calendarFeed.created-description: Copy this link into your calendar app. It is shown only now; if you lose it, create a new one.
calendarFeed.copy-failed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
calendarFeed.active-description: The link ending in {prefix} is subscribed in your calendar. Create a new link to replace it; the old one stops working.
calendarFeed.empty: You do not have a calendar link yet.
calendarFeed.totp-hint: Only needed if you use two-factor authentication.
calendarFeed.instructions-google: Google Calendar: Other calendars → From URL → paste the link.
calendarFeed.instructions-apple: Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription → paste the link.
calendarFeed.instructions-refresh: Your calendar app refreshes the feed on its own schedule.
calendarFeed.instructions-privacy: The feed shows only the bills you can see. A private account belonging to the other household member does not appear.
calendarFeed.revoke-description: Your calendar will stop receiving the bills. You can create a new link later.
calendarFeed.error-create: Could not create the link. Try again.
calendarFeed.error-totp-required: Enter your authenticator code to create the link.
calendarFeed.error-invalid-totp: That authenticator code is not valid.
calendarFeed.error-session-not-fresh: Please sign in again before creating the link.
calendarFeed.error-revoke: Could not revoke the link. Try again.
